en.title: Balance · 12-round graph discovery
en.question: Which apparent effects survive controlled interventions?
en.description: Follow load placement, beam control, ball relocation and target moves through 12 actual graph updates, ending with four retained links.
en.scope: One custom Balance task-state discovery run: supervised visual-anchor repair, operated-value affine calibration, then frozen pixel-based revisable graph scoring. 48 observations, 12 rounds and 124 intervention trials; calibration uses 88 separate trials and fresh interface confirmation uses 96 trials. Both pre- and post-calibration task-state accuracy were 100% on confirmation, so this is not a calibration-benefit comparison. Continuous beam–ball feedback is retained physically; the displayed graph uses the declared task states. Not a new paper benchmark result or independent integrity certification.

zh.title: 平衡模组 · 12轮图发现
zh.question: 通过受控干预后，哪些表面上的影响仍然成立？
zh.description: 跟随载荷放置、横梁控制、小球搬运和目标移动，查看12轮实际图更新，以及最终保留的四条边。
zh.scope: 一组自建 Balance 任务状态图发现记录：监督视觉锚点修复、操作值仿射校准，再用冻结的像素接口进行可撤回图评分。48次观测、12轮共124次干预；校准另使用88次试验，独立接口确认使用96次试验。确认集上校准前后的任务状态准确率均为100%，因此不是校准收益对照。物理上的梁–球反馈仍然存在，展示的图采用已定义的任务状态；不作为新增论文基准结果或独立完整性认证。
zh.badge: 像素＋校准 · 实际图更新

en.title: Balance · left/right load pair
en.question: With the same mass and initial context, what changes when the load is placed on the other side?
en.description: Two matched simulation trials show opposite load placements and the resulting beam and ball response. The robot performs the relocation.
en.scope: Recorded simulator outcomes, not decoder predictions. The pair holds context and mass fixed; it illustrates a physical intervention contrast, not a model counterfactual accuracy result.

zh.title: 平衡模组 · 左右载荷配对
zh.question: 保持质量与初始情境相同，将载荷换到另一侧会怎样？
zh.description: 两场匹配的仿真试验对比左右载荷放置，以及横梁和球的响应；机械臂负责搬运。
zh.scope: 这是记录的仿真结果，不是解码器预测。配对保持情境和质量一致，展示物理干预对照，不代表模型反事实准确率。

en.title: Balance · target-position pair
en.question: Does moving the goal change the physical scene, or only its match readout?
en.description: The robot relocates the target marker between matched trials. Moving the target is distinguished from changing the beam or ball dynamics.
en.scope: The match variable is a horizontal-distance readout, not a mechanical attraction or success probability. These are simulator replays, not model-generated images.

zh.title: 平衡模组 · 目标位置配对
zh.question: 移动目标，改变的是物理状态，还是与目标的匹配读数？
zh.description: 机械臂在配对试验间搬动目标标记，区分“目标变化”与“横梁或球的动力学变化”。
zh.scope: 匹配变量是水平距离读数，不是机械吸引力或成功概率。画面是仿真重放，不是模型生成图像。

en.title: Pick-and-place · six-node graph learning
en.question: Which object-state relations are supported by gripper and transport operations?
en.description: The recorded process compares observational candidates with two intervention batches while the robot grasps, carries, places, and withdraws.
en.scope: This frozen visual-interface run does not include learned calibration. The graph is a task-level candidate output, not a certified dynamics DAG. Gripper coordinates are measured states rather than automatically exogenous commands. Missing and unresolved relations remain visible; match denotes horizontal alignment, not placement success.

zh.title: 抓取放置 · 六节点图学习
zh.question: 夹爪和搬运操作，为哪些物体状态关系提供了证据？
zh.description: 记录的过程将观察候选图与两批干预证据比较；机械臂完成抓取、搬运、放置和撤回。
zh.scope: 这组冻结视觉接口运行未加入学习型校准。图是任务层候选输出，不是认证的动力学 DAG。夹爪坐标是测量状态，不能自动当作外生命令。漏检和未定向关系保留；匹配程度指水平对齐，不等于放置成功。
zh.badge: 候选图 · 接触检查的重放

en.title: Pick-and-place · open/closed gripper pair
en.question: Under a matched arm operation, how does gripper closure change the object's response?
en.description: Compare physical trials with different gripper spacing and inspect whether the object follows the transporting arm.
en.scope: A paired simulation-operation demonstration with contact checks. It is not a separately trained baseline or a decoder-generated counterfactual.

zh.title: 抓取放置 · 夹爪开合配对
zh.question: 在匹配的机械臂操作中，夹爪闭合如何改变物体响应？
zh.description: 比较不同夹爪间距的真实物理试验，观察物体是否随搬运中的机械臂移动。
zh.scope: 这是经过接触检查的配对仿真操作，不是独立训练的基线，也不是解码器生成的反事实图像。

publication_note: Per-clip metadata identifies each recorded run; paper benchmark tables are unchanged.
